message: prototype: foundation (scaffold, contracts core, mock API platform, SPA shell)

report.integrate:
FOUNDATION-INTEGRATE is complete (resumed after the interruption; nothing from this step had been written before). Every required gate passes:
- typecheck and typecheck:ui
- lint and lint:ui
- test:unit: 18 files, 709 tests
- test:ui: 24 files, 182 tests; ci:test:ui asserts 182/182 with none skipped
- build
- ci:security: secret scan clean; bundle scan clean, including the new production CSP check
- test:e2e:prototype: shell spec 5/5

Runtime smoke on port 4190 with the real local Supabase stack (auth:personas: 0 created, 43 updated):
- health returned 200 {"status":"ok","version":"v1"} with x-correlation-id.
- tebogo.officer signed in with the password grant; /me/context returned 200 with 1 membership (kwu) and environment.mode 'prototype'.
- A forged signature and a malformed token both got 401.
- Tenants the persona is not a member of (3 and 999) got the uniform 403 problem+json TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED through /me/context?tenantId=.
- Deviation: no /api/v1/buyer/... route is served yet. The buyer shared-surface handlers belong to the workspace domain, and unknown routes must return 404 before auth (brief §5.1), so /api/v1/buyer/tenders returned 404. I proved the buyer-route 403 over real HTTP instead: a scratch server on port 4191 used the real middleware, the real JWT and the test-only platform endpoint GET /api/v1/buyer/test-platform/ping. X-Tenant-Id 2 returned 200; 3, 999 and 'abc' each returned the identical 403 application/problem+json.
- All servers were stopped, including an orphaned node child on 4190, and no listeners remain on 4180, 5280, 4190, 4191 or 5290.

Fix-only integration edits (resolving the foundation followUps):
- src/contracts/catalog.ts (new): ENDPOINT_MAPS, ENDPOINT_CATALOG, endpointById and pathsCollide over the 7 shared-surface maps.
- src/contracts/catalog.test.ts (new): discovers every *Endpoints export in src/contracts/*.ts and checks validity, unique ids, unique METHOD+path pairs and route collisions across ALL modules, even before A3 lists a map.
- scripts/dev/serve-mock-api.ts: loadLocalEnv() loads the repo .env.local with process.loadEnvFile when it exists (existing variables win), so the plain `npx tsx` command works. Test added.
- scripts/ci/scan-bundle.ts: checkProductionCsp() asserts dist/index.html has a filled CSP meta tag and that script-src has no 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval' or ws:. The DEP0190 warning is fixed with a single command string. Test added.
- src/mock-api/testing/tests/demo-accounts.test.ts (new): the SPA demoAccountList and the fixture PERSONAS list the same 42 accounts, with the same names.
- src/ui/src/zodConfig.ts (new, imported first in main.tsx) calls z.config({ jitless: true }). Test added.
- src/ui/public/favicon.svg (new) and a <link rel=icon> in src/ui/index.html.
- i18n namespace conflict fixed: the workspace domain is planned to own features/approvals and features/documents, but the shell reserved those i18n namespaces, so their catalogs would have been dropped. The shell widget namespaces are renamed to approvalWidget and documentWidget (en.ts, RESERVED_NAMESPACES, the 7 widget files). A test checks that every planned feature directory name is free.

docs/plan/foundation-contract.md is rewritten as the verified contract. It covers:
- defineEndpoint, common, enums, permissions, decimal and catalog, with a compiled example.
- mockRoute, the handler context, fixture conventions, the auto-discovery module shape and the handler test helpers, with an example run end to end (200 / 409 declared code / 201 / 422 CODE|message / 403 tenant / 403 permission).
- call(), the hooks and the domain client pattern. The previous doc wrongly showed useApiQuery taking a wrapper function; the hooks take the endpoint object.
- FeatureModule/NavItem, every shared component with its props, the format helpers, the URL map, all personas and tenants with ids, the port table, and a verified Playwright screenshot script.
